line.name: Saint Luis Rey Reserva Especial
line.description: Handcrafted in Santa Rosa de Copan, Honduras; marketed as a 'super premium' tier within the brand, blending Honduran, Nicaraguan, and Peruvian tobaccos with rich coffee/tobacco notes. Offers both a natural and a Mexican-maduro wrapper option applied across the vitola range - 'Maduro Churchill' (the Mac photo) means the Churchill vitola in the maduro wrapper, not a separately named vitola.
line.wrapper: Nicaraguan EMS (natural option) or Mexican San Andres/Morron (maduro option)
line.binder_note: Not stated on the retailer page used as the primary source - not fabricated.
line.filler: Honduran, Nicaraguan, and Peruvian (per a JR Cigars brand-history page; not independently re-confirmed on a current Reserva Especial-specific product page)
